name: netsuite
description: 连接 NetSuite ERP。用用户自己的 OAuth 2.0 客户端证书向账户专属 SuiteTalk REST 换取访问令牌，并读取 metadata-catalog。未配置时不发请求，不创建集成记录，不写 ERP。

netsuite_account_id.title: NETSUITE_ACCOUNT_ID
netsuite_account_id.description: Required NetSuite account ID in exact spelling, such as 123456 or 123456_SB1. No default. This package does not create an account.

netsuite_suitetalk_url.title: NETSUITE_SUITETALK_URL
netsuite_suitetalk_url.description: Required SuiteTalk origin from Setup > Company > Company Information > Company URLs. Example: https://123456-sb1.suitetalk.api.netsuite.com. Origin only. No default.

netsuite_client_id.title: NETSUITE_CLIENT_ID
netsuite_client_id.description: Required OAuth 2.0 integration client ID. No default. This package does not create an integration record. Not logged.

netsuite_certificate_id.title: NETSUITE_CERTIFICATE_ID
netsuite_certificate_id.description: Required certificate ID (kid) from OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials (M2M) Setup. No default. Not logged.

netsuite_jwt_alg.title: NETSUITE_JWT_ALG
netsuite_jwt_alg.description: Required JWT alg for the mapped certificate: PS256, PS384, PS512, ES256, ES384, or ES512. No default.

netsuite_private_key_pem.title: NETSUITE_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM
netsuite_private_key_pem.description: Required private key PEM for the certificate mapped on the M2M setup page. No default. Not logged. This package does not read a key file and does not create a certificate.
